indicators.name: Spatial change alert tickets generated per calendar month
indicators.target_note: Establish baseline from the pilot; alert volume alone is not a quality measure.
indicators.calculation: Count distinct alert IDs created during the reporting month; separate raw candidates, deduplicated alerts, review-accepted alerts, and verified closures.

indicators.name: Recall for independently verified changes larger than 0.1 hectares
indicators.calculation: Detected eligible reference changes divided by all eligible independently verified reference changes in the evaluation set, multiplied by 100.
indicators.caveat: Never present this as a universal guarantee; disclose dataset, time window, exclusions, cloud and sensor limitations.

indicators.name: Unique community members and local council leaders successfully onboarded
indicators.calculation: Count deduplicated user records that completed the defined consent and onboarding flow in the declared pilot zone.

indicators.name: USSD/SMS gateway transaction outcomes
indicators.calculation: Report submitted, provider-accepted, delivered, failed, timed-out, and unknown transactions separately.
indicators.caveat: Provider acceptance is not proof of handset delivery or user receipt; no live messaging without pilot authorization.

indicators.name: Officer dashboard spatial query and visualization latency
indicators.calculation: Measure p50, p95, and p99 for a predeclared query set and workload; target p95 below 2 seconds.

indicators.name: Policy brief submitted to NEMA
required_evidence: formal receipt or acknowledgement if supplied
indicators.caveat: Submission or institutional endorsement must not be inferred from draft creation.

indicators.name: Dissemination workshop held at Muni University
indicators.caveat: Count only after the event occurs; do not imply partnership or endorsement without documentation.
